stage0013_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
Terrorist
「We've confirmed a riot in Colony Ariel!」

stage0013_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
Terrorist
「Did our comrades make a move?」

stage0013_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
Terrorist
「The situation's unclear.
　But this is our chance to seize Vice Minister
　Darlian and Princess $$マリナ$$」

stage0013_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
Terrorist
「Earth-Space reconciliation? Unneeded...!
　Anyone who preaches that is our enemy!」

stage0013_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
Terrorist
「All units, breach Ariel!
　Seize both to bargain with Earth Federation!」

stage0013_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
Terrorist
「Ariel has no real defense force!
　Once we breach the colony, we've won!」

stage0013_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
（$$リリーナ$$...
　Your enemy is my enemy）

stage0013_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
Terrorist
「That $$リーオー$$ means to get in our way!」

stage0013_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
Terrorist
「Ignore it!
　One unit alone can't do a thing!」

stage0013_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Let's go.
　No time for idle chatter」

stage0013_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$刹那$$
「Even without a Gundam,
　there's still something we must do」

stage0013_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But we're not the only ones fighting」

stage0013_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ヒイロ$$...!
　And that Flag with you is...」

stage0013_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ファ$$
「Is Celestial Being cooperating
　with $$プリベンター$$ too?」

stage0013_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$刹那$$
「We've been tracking colony movements
　on our own, and learned of a group waging
　terror in the name of colony liberation」

stage0013_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$リディ$$
「So that Flag is piloted by
　a Celestial Being Gundam Meister...」

stage0013_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$n
「Celestial Being...
　The private armed group that aims to
　eradicate war... Still active, huh」

stage0013_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Fighting terrorists in secret,
　same as $$ミスリル$$」

stage0013_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$カツ$$
「So that's $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$,
　the one who piloted the $$ダブルオーライザー$$...」

stage0013_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$スズネ$$
「In the movie he was all hot-blooded hero,
　but the real one's a bit different」

stage0013_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$オットー$$
「All units, keep terrorists from the colony!
　Target whoever closes in!」

stage0013_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Wasting time here of all places...!」

stage0013_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$オットー$$
「Please understand the situation, $$アルベルト$$.
　The terrorists are targeting Vice Minister
　Darlian and Princess $$マリナ$$」

stage0013_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$オットー$$
「Vice Minister Darlian works for
　Earth-Space reconciliation, and Princess
　$$マリナ$$ is admired as a symbol of peace...」

stage0013_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$オットー$$
「If those two fall into terrorist hands,
　do you get how much trouble that'd bring?」

stage0013_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$アルベルト$$
（Tch...!
　We might be on the brink of
　an even bigger crisis than that!）

stage0013_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$刹那$$
「Let's go, $$ヒイロ$$.
　We can't let them have those two」

stage0013_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$オットー$$
「Looks like we managed to protect them...」

stage0013_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Leave the cleanup to $$プリベンター$$'s agents.
　Get this ship to Industrial 7, quickly」

stage0013_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$レイアム$$
「It looks like we may not have that option...!」

stage0013_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$リディ$$
「But their gear's different from
　those old Zeon and OZ relics!」

stage0013_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That lead mobile suit, a new model...!」

stage0013_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$トロワ$$
「This unit's name is $$サーペント$$」

stage0013_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's $$トロワ・バートン$$...
　One of the colony Gundam pilots
　who fought us in $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$」

stage0013_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$レイアム$$
「The newly appeared force seems to be
　targeting us, not the colony」

stage0013_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Don't tell me they're here to stall me...」

stage0013_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$オットー$$
「What do you mean, $$アルベルト$$?」

stage0013_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「T-they're probably Neo Zeon agents!
　Captain! Intercept them, now!」

stage0013_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$オットー$$
「Damn it...! If they're attacking first,
　we've no choice but to fight back!」

stage0013_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Unable to continue combat.
　Falling back」

stage0013_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$リディ$$
「Still, after attacking us like that,
　they pulled back awfully easily...」

stage0013_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I know.
　That's his way of sending a message」

stage0013_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Looks like things wrapped up here too」

stage0013_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Are $$リリーナ$$ and the princess safe?」

stage0013_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$デュオ$$, tell us what happened in the colony」

stage0013_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$デュオ$$
「I'll tell you aboard your ship.
　Not sure what's going on, but we'd best hurry」

stage0013_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$レイアム$$
「The terrorists have latched onto Ariel!」

stage0013_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$オットー$$
「Knock them down, now!
　Don't let them into the colony, no matter what!」

stage0013_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$刹那$$
「If humanity can't stop fighting,
　we'll fight on till they see their error...!」

stage0013_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$刹那$$
「That's our mission, as Celestial Being...!」

stage0013_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What are you playing at, $$トロワ$$?」

stage0013_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$トロワ$$
「My actions are all there is」

stage0013_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Fine.
　Then I'll take you down」

stage0013_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$トロワ・バートン$$...!
　Who's behind you!?」

stage0013_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$刹那$$
「If you won't answer, then I'll
　strike the Barton Foundation directly...!」

stage0013_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I sense no killing intent from $$トロワ$$...!?
　What does this mean...」

stage0013_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$トロワ$$
（$$カミーユ$$... you noticed my intent）

stage0013_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$n
「This guy...!
　No wonder, he's a Gundam pilot!」

stage0013_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$トロワ$$
「An unseasoned soldier has no place
　on the battlefield. It only adds to grief」

stage0013_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$n
「If words like that could make me quit,
　I'd have drowned in fear long ago!」
